description: Use when an agent needs the text of a PDF as markdown. Returns the text of the one PDF URL you pass, page by page as markdown, with title, page count and word count. http or https, 10 MB, 10 s; robots.txt honoured and private addresses refused. A file that is not a PDF, a PDF with no text layer (a scan), or an unreachable URL, is never charged. Costs 0.01 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

url.description: the PDF to convert: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_pdf_markdown

data.description: the get_pdf_markdown payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_pdf_markdown

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: PDF to markdown
